title: FinTrust Project Progress
subtitle: Single living status and milestone record

sections.title: Current Snapshot
paragraphs: 13 October 2026 | Implementation checkpoint 48399b9 | Local E2E verified; live AWS E2E pending. Existing budget controls verified and preserved.

20 scenarios have passing local evidence across 125 selected tests, real isolated PostgreSQL, authenticated UI/API checks and mocked AWS transports. Individual browser versus API evidence is labeled. Historical full regression remains 811 passed / 1 expected administrator-only skip; it was not rerun for this documentation phase.

Read-only AWS check verified fintrust-admin in account 966467878406 and infrastructure region af-south-1. The five foundation/ingest stacks remain CREATE_COMPLETE. Existing ingest concurrency remains 0; RDS remains private Single-AZ with 20 GiB gp3. No AWS mutation, deployment or push occurred.

sections.title: Completed

Historical base bootstrap/001/002 and service-role PG16 checks retained. Current lifecycle proof adds 21 PG16 tests. No live write is implied.

Named user governance, private local enrollment, active-role checks, immutable quarantine correction/outcome timeline, single-owner review claim/reassignment including escalated recovery, scoped queue filters and Admin/Analyst/Auditor browser controls.

Scoped Risk Event investigation, measured frozen rule evidence, same-currency account context, related transactions, filtered counts/sort, list-preserving detail, append-only Analyst notes, independent delivery state and compact user search. Existing quarantine/assignment controls remain verified.

Direct UI wording at 58fa83f, followed by README and authoritative documentation cleanup. Analyst workbench: six scoped metrics, active-review table, four evidence charts, issue links, independent errors and no fabricated SLA. Risk Events adds the existing Over SLA path; quarantine adds recorded age and a clear correction action; Admin user sorting/filtering and disable/reactivate remain verified.

Existing FinTrust-Monthly-Budget (USD 10/month; 50/80/100% ACTUAL and 100% FORECASTED) and My Zero-Spend Budget (ACTUAL > USD 0.01) verified, healthy and preserved. Same existing email subscriber on all five alerts; masked evidence retained. No duplicate/replacement budget created or current budget deleted.

sections.title: In Progress
paragraphs: AWS Integration remains In Progress. Local E2E is verified; live AWS E2E is pending. Budgets remain account-wide because Project and Environment cost-allocation tags are inactive. Recipient configuration is verified; activation status/actual delivery were not exposed or tested in this API check.

sections.title: Blocked
paragraphs: Live promotion requires reviewed empty-database bootstrap and 001/002/003/004/005 chain, correct service grants and fresh exact-source Linux artifact gate. Existing fixed live runner does not include 003.
Cloud intake, FIFO/Streams mappings, authenticated API, SES delivery and operational monitoring still require controlled live evidence. Historical Linux artifacts remain valid only for their source.

sections.title: Deferred
paragraphs: Hourly velocity exploration; refunds/reversals/chargebacks; FX and current-balance engine; HA/Multi-AZ/proxy; enterprise federation; durable notifications; full report-object catalogue; archival deletion; automatic DLQ lifecycle observation; AI Investigation Assistant.

sections.title: Next Actions
paragraphs: Run exact-source Linux Python 3.12 x86_64 verification before changing packages or deploying. Existing budgets need no cosmetic rename. Monitor alert emails and ongoing RDS/retained-storage costs; review tag activation and complete attribution separately.

Then seek separate approval for live bootstrap/migrations and deployment/wiring, verify SES, retries/DLQ and reports, and run live AWS E2E. Preserve the distinction between local and live evidence. AI Investigation Assistant remains last.

sections.title: Decision Log
paragraphs: Retain candidate-before-DB-validation chronology; keep processing, risk, review and delivery separate; accept all valid risk levels; original quarantine is terminal and corrections are new linked occurrences.
Retain >5 accepted transactions / 300 seconds, not >10/hour. Keep no-NAT/private RDS. Require in-memory bootstrap credential retrieval over a reviewed private endpoint and verify-full.
Master owns project explanation; Progress owns status/history; EVIDENCE owns proof. Technical contracts remain supporting sources, not alternative readiness declarations.

Reuse existing immutable correction/review history and current state models. Explicit Admin reassignment preserves escalated decision evidence. Keep SLA configurable without inventing a deadline; retain controlled local authentication and no role inheritance.

Datadog official investigation guidance informs information density and side-panel interactions only; the original FinTrust brief, RBAC and frozen risk rules remain authoritative. Reuse immutable review history for notes through additive 005; no second review model.

Reuse existing scoped read APIs for workbench counts. Display Not configured when no SLA exists; distinguish high-risk flags from delivery receipts; disclose bounded and overlapping counts. Keep human decisions, quarantine recovery and RBAC unchanged.

Preserve working budget names rather than create replacements. Budget thresholds are warnings, not a cap. Keep account-wide controls until activated cost tags and full attribution are reviewed; do not claim recipient delivery from subscriber configuration alone.

sections.title: Issues and Resolutions
paragraphs: Tagged-create IAM failures: controlled diagnostics and provider-specific permission corrections recorded; static validation alone was insufficient.
Live database missing base schema: read-only preflight stopped incremental migration; temporary billable infrastructure cleaned up, evidence retained.
Stale local entry and login restart: authenticated workspace routing and existing hashed identity preservation fixed.
Lifecycle recovery: distinguish durable financial STORED from external projection failure; compare latest failure/recovery sequence so multiple failed attempts recover correctly.
Unresolved: current-source Linux gate, live bootstrap/003/004/005 privileges and integration. No claim of production readiness.
